@@note: Every word the game shows or says, apart from the cards (they live in build/decks). Shaped like Google's ARB: each string's id, then "@id" with a note on where it shows. {name} is a placeholder the game fills in. No HTML: the game sets digits and GOLAZO! in the arcade face and glues punctuation to its word. Morg approves every string. Edit, then run python3 build/build.py.

@brand.note: The game's name: the page title, the Home Screen name, the link preview's title and the sign's spoken name (the sign itself is drawn dots)

meta.description: How well do you know the beautiful game?

@meta.description.note: The link preview's line under the name, in Messages and social apps

@sign.sub.note: Under TRIVIELA on the sign, in small arcade capitals (shown uppercase). One line on every phone. The ⚽ is drawn as the game’s own little ball, so the sign never names the sport and every player reads it in their own word (Morg, Oct 26, 2026). Screen readers skip it

board.slogan: How well do you know the beautiful game?

@board.slogan.note: Printed on the cabinet between the screen and the cards, on the board only. One line on every phone

@board.pick.note: Board: below the cards, in glowing screen letters, over the line of card colors. Shows all day (Morg, Oct 28, 2026, in place of How to play)

@board.easier.note: Board: under Pick a card, left of the three card colors

@board.harder.note: Board: under Pick a card, right of the three card colors

board.legend: Card colors, from easier to harder: green, yellow, red

@board.legend.note: Spoken: the line of card colors under Pick a card

menu.label: Menu

@menu.label.note: Spoken name of the three-bar key in the sign's corner and of the menu sheet

@menu.restart.note: Menu key, the 7-board demo only. Starts back at board #1 (asks first). The menu shows only in the demo

@menu.close.note: The menu's full-width bottom key, closes the menu

@restart.q.note: Pop-up question after Start over in the menu, the 7-board demo only

@restart.no.note: Pop-up key: closes it, nothing changes

@play.next.note: The full-width key after answering a card, back to the board. Shown in capitals

@play.back.note: The key under the answers before you answer: back to the board, the card still to play (Morg, Oct 26, 2026, a placeholder). Shown in capitals

@play.blank.note: Spoken in place of the sentence's blank

tile.label: {hook}, {tag}, {color}

@tile.label.note: A tile's spoken name, before it's played

@tile.right.note: A played tile's spoken name, answered right

@tile.missed.note: A played tile's spoken name, missed

@tag.basics.note: Category tag over a tile's hook: the 101 deck, the basics

@tag.rules.note: Category tag: the Laws of the Game deck

@tag.lingo.note: Category tag: both lingo decks, the game's words

@tag.slang.note: Category tag: Kid Slang and Parent Slang

@tag.epl.note: Category tag: both Premier League decks

@tag.bundesliga.note: Category tag. The widest one: check it on the smallest phone

@tag.world.note: Category tag: international men's and women's

@golazo.note: All 15 right: the shout over the ball, the end screen's score and the share's score line. Always in the arcade face (Morg's name and caps)

@end.grid.note: The end screen grid's spoken name: the three row lines joined by commas

rows.example: Green: 2 of 3, Yellow: 3 of 3, Red: 1 of 3

@end.row.note: One column of the end grid, spoken

@row.1.note: The green column's spoken name on the end grid

@end.score.note: The day's score: on the end screen, in the share and in the image

@end.thanks.note: Top of the end screen on the demo's last board

@end.next.note: The demo's key to the next board

@end.again.note: The demo's last board: back to #1

@end.sboard.note: End screen key beside the countdown, or the whole row with one fixed board: shares the board as a picture

@end.sgrid.note: End screen: the share key's label, at the right of its first line, before the share icon. Shares the grid as text (Morg, Oct 28, 2026: our two words are grid and board)

@end.nextIn.note: End screen: a small line over the countdown to tomorrow's board

end.reviewHint: Tap a card to read it again

@end.reviewHint.note: End screen: under the score. Tapping a ball or card in the grid opens that card again

@review.count.note: End screen, a card again: which card this is, at the top beside its ball or card

@review.next.note: End screen, a card again: at the bottom, on every card but the last

@review.back.note: End screen, a card again: at the bottom of the last card

share.title: Triviela #{day}β

@share.title.note: The share text's first line, also shown on the share key. The β marks the playtest's numbers, which start over at launch (Morg, Oct 26, 2026)

@share.tagline.note: What the game is, in the share: the line over triviela.net in the text (a link’s preview card shows only when the link ends the message) and under it in the Share board picture (Morg, Oct 26, 2026). Never soccer or football

@share.site.note: The share text's last line, on the share key and at the bottom of the image

share.label: Share: {text}

@share.label.note: Spoken name of the share key

image.title: TRIVIELA

@image.title.note: The Share board image's heading, in arcade capitals

@image.score.note: The image's score line, under its heading. The β as in share.title

@image.file.note: The image's file name when shared

@image.alt.note: Spoken name of the image in its pop-up on a computer

@image.close.note: Closes the image pop-up on a computer

@beta.flagged.note: Beta only (Morg): brief message after flagging a card

@beta.queued.note: Beta only: a mark saved on the phone with no signal

@beta.flag.note: Beta only: spoken name of the yellow Flag key

@beta.unflag.note: Beta only: spoken name of the Flag key once flagged

@beta.lock.note: Beta only: spoken name of the green Lock key

@beta.unlock.note: Beta only: spoken name of the Lock key once locked

@beta.note.note: Beta only: the phone's own prompt after Flag

gate.title: MEMBERS ONLY

@gate.title.note: The 104 lock (switched off): heading over the code slots

@gate.code.note: The lock: spoken name of the code slots

@gate.clear.note: The lock: spoken name of the clear key

@gate.enter.note: The lock: spoken name of the enter key
